ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 (ScarCruft) ROKRAT cloud C2 — non-browser process talking to pCloud/Yandex/Dropbox/Box APIs
ucs.description: Hunts ROKRAT and its variants' characteristic abuse of legitimate cloud storage APIs (pCloud, Yandex Disk, Dropbox, Box) as bidirectional C2 channels — a hallmark of ScarCruft/Reaper since 2018 across DOGCALL, ROKRAT, and CHINOTTO families. The detection requires the cloud API endpoint to be reached by a non-browser, non-cloud-client process, which catches the implant without alerting on legitimate end-user use of the same services.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as dest_ip values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as dest_port from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest IN ("api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.ru","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","upload.box.com","api.box.com") by All_Traffic.src host All_Traffic.app All_Traffic.process_name All_Traffic.user All_Traffic.dest _time span=1h | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | search NOT process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","opera.exe","Dropbox.exe","Box.exe","YandexDisk.exe","pcloud.exe","pCloud.exe","safari.exe") | join type=outer host process_name [| tstats summariesonly=t values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes by Processes.dest Processes.process_name | rename Processes.dest as host Processes.process_name as process_name] | where firstTime >= relative_time(now(), "-7d")
ucs.kql:
let CloudC2Hosts = dynamic(["api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.ru","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","upload.box.com","api.box.com"]);
let KnownClients = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","opera.exe","safari.exe","dropbox.exe","box.exe","yandexdisk.exe","pcloud.exe","outlook.exe","onedrive.exe"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (CloudC2Hosts)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (KnownClients)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | project DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId=ProcessId, ChildCmd=ProcessCommandLine, ParentName=InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine
) on DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), ConnCount=count(), CloudDomains=make_set(RemoteUrl, 10), DestIPs=make_set(RemoteIP, 10), SampleCmd=any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), SampleParent=any(ParentName)
          by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| where ConnCount >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let CloudC2Hosts = dynamic(["api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.ru","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","upload.box.com","api.box.com"]);
let KnownClients = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","opera.exe","safari.exe","dropbox.exe","box.exe","yandexdisk.exe","pcloud.exe","outlook.exe","onedrive.exe"]);
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Url has_any (CloudC2Hosts) or HttpHostName has_any (CloudC2Hosts)
| extend ProcName = tolower(tostring(split(SrcUsername, "\\")[-1]))
| where isnotempty(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent)
| where not(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent has_any ("Mozilla/5.0","Dropbox","YandexDisk","pCloud","Box.com"))
| summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated), ReqCount=count(), CloudDomains=make_set(HttpHostName, 10), SampleUA=any(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent)
          by DvcHostname, SrcUsername, SrcIpAddr
| where ReqCount >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc

title: APT37 ROKRAT Cloud Service C2 (pCloud/Yandex/Dropbox/Box)
id: 7c3a8d10-1e6b-4a2d-9c2f-aa37rok11001
status: experimental
description: Detects non-browser processes communicating with cloud storage APIs known to be abused by APT37 (ScarCruft) ROKRAT family for bidirectional C2.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2021/11/18/strategic-web-compromises-middle-east-suspected-apt-actor/
author: SOC detection-engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.g0067
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  cloud_c2:
    DestinationHostname|contains:
      - 'api.pcloud.com'
      - 'eapi.pcloud.com'
      - 'cloud-api.yandex.net'
      - 'webdav.yandex.ru'
      - 'content.dropboxapi.com'
      - 'api.dropboxapi.com'
      - 'upload.box.com'
      - 'api.box.com'
  filter_browsers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\iexplore.exe'
      - '\opera.exe'
      - '\Dropbox.exe'
      - '\Box.exe'
      - '\YandexDisk.exe'
      - '\pcloud.exe'
      - '\OneDrive.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
  condition: cloud_c2 and not filter_browsers
falsepositives:
  - Custom scripts that legitimately back up data to these services via API
  - Third-party sync clients with non-standard binary names
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:3 (@DestinationHostname:(*api.pcloud.com OR *eapi.pcloud.com OR *cloud-api.yandex.net OR *webdav.yandex.ru OR *content.dropboxapi.com OR *api.dropboxapi.com OR *upload.box.com OR *api.box.com)) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\brave.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\IExplore.exe OR *\Dropbox.exe OR *\DROPBOX.EXE OR *\Box.exe OR *\YandexDisk.exe OR *\pCloud.exe OR *\pcloud.exe OR *\OneDrive.exe OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(api\.pcloud\.com|eapi\.pcloud\.com|cloud-api\.yandex\.net|webdav\.yandex\.ru|content\.dropboxapi\.com|api\.dropboxapi\.com|upload\.box\.com|api\.box\.com)$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|iexplore|opera|safari|dropbox|box|yandexdisk|pcloud|onedrive|outlook)\.exe$/i
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2}, field=[aid, ContextProcessId], key=[aid, TargetProcessId], include=[ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData, ParentBaseFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, SHA256HashData], function=[count(as=conns), collect([DomainName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], multival=true)])
| conns >= 2

ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 Hancom HWP/HOffice spawning script interpreters — ScarCruft Korean-lure spearphishing chain
ucs.description: Hunts the post-exploitation execution stage of APT37 spearphishing campaigns that weaponize Hangul Word Processor (.hwp) documents — a near-exclusive APT37/Lazarus tradecraft because Hancom Office is overwhelmingly deployed in South Korean government, defector NGOs, and journalism orgs that APT37 targets. The detection fires on the unmistakable parent-child shape where Hwp.exe / Hword.exe / Hcell.exe / Hshow.exe spawns a script interpreter or LOLBin.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hash from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("Hwp.exe","hwp.exe","HwpApp.exe","Hword.exe","Hcell.exe","Hshow.exe","Hwpviewer.exe","HncBrowser.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wmic.exe","hh.exe","installutil.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where firstTime >= relative_time(now(), "-7d") | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let HancomParents = dynamic(["hwp.exe","hwpapp.exe","hword.exe","hcell.exe","hshow.exe","hwpviewer.exe","hncbrowser.exe"]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wmic.exe","hh.exe","installutil.exe","msbuild.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (HancomParents)
| where FileName in~ (SuspiciousChildren)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend HighSignalCmd = ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-EC ","FromBase64String","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression","hidden","-w h","bypass","-nop","javascript:","vbscript:","\\AppData\\","\\Temp\\","\\ProgramData\\")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentSHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256,
          ChildImage = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ChildSHA256 = SHA256,
          HighSignalCmd
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let HancomParents = dynamic(["hwp.exe","hwpapp.exe","hword.exe","hcell.exe","hshow.exe","hwpviewer.exe","hncbrowser.exe"]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wmic.exe","hh.exe","installutil.exe","msbuild.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentName in (HancomParents)
| where ChildName in (SuspiciousChildren)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend HighSignalCmd = CommandLine has_any ("-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-EC ","FromBase64String","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression","hidden","-w h","bypass","-nop","javascript:","vbscript:","\\AppData\\","\\Temp\\","\\ProgramData\\")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, HighSignalCmd
| order by TimeGenerated desc
